purpose: Measure reference-cycle sensitivity without post-hoc selection on the final holdout.

evidence_chain.lineage_rule: holdout_lock.development_selection_artifact_hash must equal sha256(canonical development selection artifact), and reported primary cycle must equal its selected_primary_cycle
evidence_chain.artifact_hash_rule: selection, holdout-lock, per-molecule result, and uncertainty hashes are recomputed from canonical artifact content; self-reported verified booleans are forbidden
cross_binding_rules: holdout_lock.frozen_holdout_hash equals canonical holdout artifact hash
each cycle n_by_molecule_hash equals canonical n-by-molecule artifact hash and every result molecule_id/n pair matches that artifact
each cycle nonreference_controls_hash equals canonical non-reference-controls artifact hash
selection.selection_policy_hash equals canonical preregistered selection-policy artifact hash
selected_primary_cycle is one of the two declared cycles
frozen absolute, Route 2 paired, holdout lock, and both reference cycles use the identical ordered frozen-holdout molecule manifest
manifest_and_adjudication_rules: reference_cycle_ablation_manifest_hash is recomputed from manifest content
manifest artifact_hashes exactly equal all recomputed artifact hashes
adjudication_hash is recomputed and adjudication.manifest_hash equals the recomputed manifest hash
selection and holdout-lock hashes equal the independent protocol-bound trusted preregistration root

rules: both declared cycle IDs are present exactly once
both cycles share frozen_holdout_hash, n_by_molecule_hash, and nonreference_controls_hash
both cycles have failure_count=0 and abstention_count=0
every declared artifact hash is recomputed and matches
holdout lock references the pre-existing development selection artifact
reported primary cycle equals the development-selected primary cycle
cycle frozen_holdout_hash equals holdout_lock.frozen_holdout_hash, not merely the other cycle row
selection, holdout-lock, result, and uncertainty hashes are recomputed from canonical artifact content
holdout_lock.frozen_holdout_hash equals canonical holdout artifact hash
each cycle n_by_molecule_hash equals canonical n-by-molecule artifact hash and every result molecule_id/n pair matches that artifact
each cycle nonreference_controls_hash equals canonical non-reference-controls artifact hash
selection.selection_policy_hash equals canonical preregistered selection-policy artifact hash
selected_primary_cycle is one of the two declared cycles
reference_cycle_ablation_manifest_hash is recomputed from manifest content
manifest artifact_hashes exactly equal all recomputed artifact hashes
adjudication_hash is recomputed and adjudication.manifest_hash equals the recomputed manifest hash
selection and holdout-lock hashes equal the independent protocol-bound trusted preregistration root

trusted_preregistration_root.runtime_requirement: production evaluation rejects synthetic/test evidence; the known-answer root is accepted only through an explicit test-only validator flag
